mentions.name: Earth Meta Insights
mentions.description: This project provides snapshot visualizations of the state of regional and global species and natural ecosystems, presented as information cards such as the gorillas of Rwanda and elephants worldwide. It combines manual research with automated tools (web and literature search, LLMs, visualizers) to search, extract, organize, and visualize ecosystem literature and data, and visitors can request snapshots of specific species and locations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Since a few months back I am working on a side project to give a snapshot of the regional and global species and natural ecosystems.

I use manual (me) and automated tools (web and literature search tools, llms, visualizers ...) to search, extract, organize and visualize ecosystem literature and data.
